attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: sum_(i<=t) sum_(r<=8) c_r(x_t) f_r(x_i) s_ti^r v_i, s_ti = Q_t K_i^T / sqrt(d_k); c(x_t) = b + (a/r!)*tanh(x_t W) per layer/head, W initially N(0, 0.03125^2) per entry, a initially 0, b_r initially 1/r!; f(x_i) = 1 + a_k*tanh(x_i W_k) per layer/head, W_k drawn like W and a_k starting like a; x_t and x_i are the key and query tokens' activations after the block input RMSNorm, then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain
